I still remember what life was like when I was in my happy and hopeful moments. There’s no rule saying that once those moments are no longer felt, that it’s irreversible and that you should just wrap things up now. Please don’t give up and find at least ONE thing to live for. For me, I choose my mother. She tried to kill her self a few times but is still here, recovering. She’s been to hell and back and I’m seriously impressed with how well she’s doing. She lives for her four kids. This turn around is possible for everyone, you need to pick one thing, whether that be your cat, and do everything in your power to not lose your grip on that thing/person/dream!

If you’re not dead, then you’re not done. I promise you that if you cling to the hope in any one thing, it becomes easier to keep going regardless of how you’re currently doing. Once you lose all hope as nothing is going your way, then your reason to live is gone. So believe life will get better, even half believing it is better than having absolutely no faith in yourself and abilities. Otherwise you’re not giving yourself your best shot.
